subject: Arlington Street Residential Additions
overview: The Medford Conservation Commission reviewed Abbreviated Notices of Intent for residential additions on Arlington Street. The Commission continued one petition for revised plans and approved the other with conditions.

items.title: Notice of Intent: 171 Arlington Street
items.summary: The Commission continued the hearing for 171 Arlington Street to October 1st to allow the applicant to submit updated plans showing accurate tree locations and a separated operations and maintenance plan.

items.title: Notice of Intent: 173 Arlington Street
items.summary: The Commission approved an order of conditions for a rear addition and deck at 173 Arlington Street, with a condition requiring any newly installed vegetation to be native.

items.title: Commission Updates and Administrative Business
items.summary: The Commission discussed outstanding meeting minutes, received an update on plantings at a South Street property, and reviewed upcoming safety-related roadwork planned by the DCR on Mystic Valley Parkway.
